# Jack Network

Jack Network is a Minecraft server running practice PvP and survival game modes.
Website: https://jacknetwork.in

## How to join

- Server address: play.jacknetwork.in
- Supported editions: Java and Bedrock, same address, no separate port.
- In Minecraft, go to Multiplayer, add the server address, and join.

## Game modes

- Practice PvP: player-versus-player combat to practice aim, timing, and game sense.
- Survival: classic shared-world survival — gather, build, and hold your ground.

## Coins

Coins are the server's virtual currency for in-game perks and cosmetics.
Ways to get coins:

1. Play in-game chat games on the Minecraft server (free).
2. Level up in the Discord server (automatic).
3. Keep the AFK page open on the store (2 coins per minute, daily limit).
4. Buy coins directly — payments are not live yet; watch Discord for the announcement.

Coin purchases, once credited, are final and non-refundable. See /terms for the full policy.

## Coin store

https://store.jacknetwork.in — the store, same login as the main site.

- Check your coin balance (from the Discord economy, no separate account).
- Link your Minecraft account with a short code (Java and Bedrock).
- AFK earning: keep the page open and visible to earn coins every minute.
- Practice PvP and Survival sections list ranks and perks as they open.
- Buying coins is not available yet — no payment provider is connected.

## Website pages

- / — homepage: hero, game modes, coins overview, live status, FAQ preview, Discord invite.
- /coins — how coins work and store status.
- /status — live server status: online state, player counts, and version, polled every 10 seconds.
- /faq — frequently asked questions about joining, coins, editions, and accounts.
- /rules — server rules for conduct, fair play, coins, and enforcement.
- /terms — Terms of Service covering the server, website, Discord, and coin system.
- /login — sign in with a Discord account (used for the coin store and account linking).
- store.jacknetwork.in — the coin store (balance, Minecraft linking, AFK earning, rank catalog).

## Community and support

- Discord: https://dsc.gg/jackknetwork
- To report a player or a bug, join the Discord and open a support ticket.

## Notes

- The server is free to join and play. Coins are optional.
- Jack Network is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by Mojang AB or Microsoft.
- Live server status on the website requires the status endpoint to be configured; when it is unavailable the site says so instead of estimating values.
